2. The facts of the case, in short, are that the plaintiff' filed Title Suit No. 39 of 1991 in the 1st Court of Assistant Judge, Barisal claiming inheritance from Achimunnessa through her daughter Elimunnessa and it was asserted that Achimunnessa died leaving behind her only daughter Elimunnessa who inherited her entire property duly and correctly recorded during K.S. and S.A. Khatian in the name of Achimunnessa and the plaintiff laid further claim by inheritance from Money Ali Khan, predecessor of the appellant to the extent of 36 acres from S.A. Khatian Nos. 377, 378, 288 and 300 and by purchase from the defendant No. 1, Abdul Rader Khan being their heir of recorded tenant Golam Habib by exhibit-1 to the extent of 34 acres from State Acquisition Khatian Nos. 9 and 282. 

 7. It appears from the R. S. and S. A Khatians the names of predecessor of defendant Nos. 1-4 including the name of defendant No. 1 appear as co-sharers with Achimunnessa. It appears from the circumstances that the defendants could not prove that they are not the heirs and successive heirs of Achimunnessa so as to inherit the interest of the suit land property on her death. The defendants are in fact and in law inherited the land of suit properties from Achimunnessa as their predecessors come within serial No. 19 of table of residuary in order of succession as male descendants of more remote true grandfather. It appears that the Court below did not at consider the claim of the defendants and as such, committed an error of law in decreeing the suit of the plaintiffs to the exclusion of the defendants who are the heirs and successive heirs of Achimunnessa. 

 9. The Courts below have decreed the suit allotting saham to the plaintiffs to the extent of 3.4812 acres of land but the High Court Division on consideration of evidence and materials on record have modified the saham and allowed the plaintiffs a decree for separate saham in respect of 2.05 acres of land instead of 3.4812 acres of land holding that the defendants are the heir and successive heirs of Kifayet Khan, Mal Khan and Mobe Khan who were none but full brothers of Salamat Khan, the paternal grandfather of Achimunnessa as evidenced by records including R.S and S.A Khatians where the names of the predecessors of defendant Nos. 1-14 appears as co-sharers with Achimunnessa. Accordingly, the defendants could not prove that they are not the heirs or successive heirs of Achimunnessa so as to inherit the interest of the land of the suit property on her death being the residuaries in order of succession as male descendants of more remote true grandfather. Accordingly, on calculation of the shares of the defendant in the suit land High Court Division accordingly decreed the suit. We have perused the said calculation and the appellant could not show any mistake or otherwise any defect in the said allotment of shares in allowing a separate saham in respect of 2.05 acres of land in favour of the plaintiffs instead of 3.48½ acres of land as decreed by the Courts below allotting 16 arenas share in suit land in favour of the plaintiff to the exclusion of shams of defendants.
